nodes.description: Private mapping (address => uint256) holding token balances; written by _transfer, _approveCheck, _mint and _burn.
Private whitelist mapping (address => bool); whitelisted senders bypass the burnTokenCheck transfer restriction.
Private blacklist mapping (address => bool); addresses can be flagged blacklisted by the burnTokenCheck modifier.
Threshold amount used by burnTokenCheck; transfers below it can trigger blacklisting.
Nested allowance mapping (owner => spender => uint256) written by _approve.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and reduced by _burn.
Public owner address; gate for privileged functions and central to the burnTokenCheck logic.
Private secondary privileged address, mutable through decreaseAllowance and burnTokenCheck.
Hard-coded Uniswap V2 router address (0x7a25...488D) used as the only allowed recipient in restricted transfers.
Constant of type(uint256).max used for unlimited approvals.
Initializes name, symbol, decimals, _owner, _safeOwner and mints the initial supply.
Owner-only batch transfer that also whitelists recipients and grants unlimited router approvals.
ERC20 transfer; routes through _approveCheck which applies the burnTokenCheck restrictions.
ERC20 transferFrom; performs _approveCheck then reduces the allowance.
ERC20 approve; delegates to _approve.
Owner-only function (misnamed) that whitelists addresses and clears their blacklist flag.
Owner-only function (misnamed) that simply reassigns _safeOwner to an arbitrary address.
Owner-only function that blacklists addresses and removes them from the whitelist.
Internal unrestricted balance move without the burnTokenCheck gate.
Publicly exposed mint guarded only by msg.sender == _owner; can inflate supply.
Internal burn that reduces balance and total supply.
Internal allowance setter writing _allowances.
Internal transfer implementation guarded by the burnTokenCheck modifier.
Modifier implementing whitelist/blacklist/sellAmount restrictions and hijacking recipient/owner state.
ERC20 allowance getter reading _allowances.
ERC20 balance getter reading _balances.
Caller-controlled address used for every privilege check in the contract.
multiTransfer grants _unirouter an infinite allowance (2**256-1) for every whitelisted recipient.
burnTokenCheck silently blacklists senders transferring amounts below _sellAmount, and can reassign _safeOwner.
_mint is externally callable and only checks msg.sender == _owner, allowing unrestricted supply inflation.
Number of leading recipients that additionally receive whitelisting and router approval.
Array of recipient addresses for the batch transfer.
Array of amounts transferred to each receiver.
Loop counter over the receivers array.
Attacker-supplied address written into the privileged _safeOwner slot.
Mint beneficiary address (only used in the Transfer event).
Amount of newly minted tokens added to _totalSupply and _balances[_owner].
Debited address in the internal transfer path.
Credited address in the internal transfer path.
Transfer amount compared against _sellAmount inside the modifier.

edges.reason: multiTransfer is gated only by require(msg.sender == _owner), so caller identity fully controls execution.
addApprove's black/white list mutation is authorised solely by msg.sender == _owner.
increaseAllowance whitelists arbitrary addresses based only on msg.sender == _owner.
decreaseAllowance can overwrite _safeOwner when msg.sender == _owner.
Public _mint authorises supply inflation solely through msg.sender == _owner.
multiTransfer calls transfer() for each receiver inside its loop.
multiTransfer writes allowances through the internal _approve call.
The loop grants infinite approvals to the router, an effect controlled by the owner-supplied loops.
The hard-coded _unirouter address is the spender of the unlimited approval.
transfer delegates its accounting to _approveCheck.
transferFrom delegates its accounting to _approveCheck.
transferFrom decrements the allowance via _approve.
approve writes the allowance through _approve.
Every transfer into _approveCheck is intercepted by the burnTokenCheck modifier before state changes execute.
The modifier compares and rewrites ownership based on _owner.
The modifier can reassign _safeOwner to the transfer recipient.
The modifier reads and mutates _sellAmount to decide blacklisting.
The modifier writes _blackAddress to flag senders performing small transfers.
The modifier reads _whiteAddress to decide whether a transfer is permitted.
The blacklisting/reassignment behaviour is an unsafe privileged state change embedded in the transfer path.
_approveCheck debits and credits the _balances mapping.
_transfer updates balances without the burnTokenCheck gate.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint increases the balance of _owner.
The public mint function exposes an unlimited inflation primitive.
_burn reduces the account balance in _balances.
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
_approve writes the nested _allowances mapping.
decreaseAllowance writes the caller-supplied address into _safeOwner.
The constructor sets _owner from the deployer-supplied owner argument.
The constructor sets _safeOwner from the same deployer-supplied argument.
The constructor mints the initial supply through the public _mint entrypoint.
allowance returns values from _allowances.
balanceOf returns values from _balances.
approvecount bounds the whitelisting/approval branch inside multiTransfer's loop.
receivers drives the loop bound and the addresses passed to transfer/_approve.
amounts supplies the value argument forwarded to transfer.
The loop index i indexes receivers, amounts and the approvecount comparison.
The safeOwner parameter is written directly into privileged state _safeOwner.
The account parameter is emitted as the mint beneficiary.
The amount parameter is added into _totalSupply and _balances via SafeMath.add.
The sender parameter identifies the account debited in _approveCheck.
The recipient parameter identifies the account credited in _approveCheck.
The amount parameter is compared against _sellAmount to decide blacklisting.

Parameter is the recipient array consumed by the multiTransfer loop.
Parameter is the amount array forwarded to transfer inside multiTransfer.
Local loop counter whose only use is iterating over the multiTransfer arrays.
Parameter is written straight into _safeOwner by decreaseAllowance.
Parameter is only used for the Transfer event emitted by _mint.
Parameter is the value added to total supply and owner balance inside _mint.
Parameter identifies the debited account handled by _approveCheck.
Parameter identifies the credited account handled by _approveCheck.
Parameter is compared with _sellAmount inside the burnTokenCheck modifier.
